title_en: Serenity: How One Anonymous "White-Hair Girl" Moved a FTSE 250 Stock 90% in Two Days
excerpt_en: Chokepoint investing, viral X influence, and what retail traders can learn—and must watch out for.
body_en:
# Serenity: How One Anonymous "White-Hair Girl" Moved a FTSE 250 Stock 90% in Two Days

> While everyone chased Nvidia, she bought the obscure suppliers giants can't live without.

## Headline numbers

In February 2026, an X account with an anime white-hair avatar posted *Fun Trading Idea, Long $RPI*.

The next day, Raspberry Pi—languishing below its IPO for months—surged 27% in the first hour and nearly **90% in two days**.

Bloomberg, Reuters, and the FT traced the move back to that single tweet.

Two months later, Raspberry Pi reported **58% revenue growth** vs **14%** consensus. Her call: **55%**.

Meet **Serenity (@aleabitoreddit)**—nicknamed **"White-Hair Stock Oracle"** in Chinese finance circles. She embraced the nickname in her bio.

In under a year, followers grew from 47k to 700k+. One tweet can move London, Stockholm, even A-share names. On June 3, 2026, her paid subscriptions surpassed Elon Musk's—**#1 on X**.

This piece covers: **why she's viral**, her **edge**, and what to **learn vs avoid**.

---

## 1. From WSB ban to must-read on Wall Street desks

Serenity remains anonymous.

She claims to be an AI/semiconductor supply-chain analyst, ex-RISC-V Foundation, even a Nature-published researcher. Unverified stories—but one fact is real: **she was permanently banned from WSB**.

Before 2022, as "AleaBito" on Reddit, she traded with extreme leverage—sometimes citing chart patterns as absurd as "tuna belly shape."

The turning point: a 10,000-word deep dive on **AXT ($AXTI)**, a ~$200M compound-semiconductor materials name. Thesis: **AI build-out hits an indium phosphide substrate bottleneck—and AXTI sits on the chokepoint.**

WSB mods banned her for "packaging a smart persona to pump."

She moved to X as **Serenity** ("the famous WSB trader, now on X").

**AXTI later ran toward $70—1,000%+ from her write-up.** That cemented her "supply-chain prophet" reputation.

---

## 2. Chokepoint Theory: don't buy the star, buy the bottleneck

One line summary:

> **Skip the glittering AI leaders; buy the irreplaceable suppliers giants physically depend on.**

She calls it **Chokepoint Theory**—like the "AXTI Strait" for indium phosphide in optical AI.

### Why it works (her view)

The debate shifted from **demand** ("how many GPUs?") to **supply** ("what breaks first?").

When "AI is the future" is consensus, crowded mega-caps deliver average returns. Alpha hides in dirty, narrow manufacturing nodes—**where a outage stops the whole cluster**.

She peels the stack: GPU → switch → optics → CPO → InP substrates → epitaxy → high-purity red phosphorus. **Higher up the chain: less coverage, slower capacity adds, longer qual cycles—bigger mispricings.**

Five filters:

1. **Demand locked?** Tied to hyperscaler capex plans.
2. **Supply narrow?** System stops without it; no fast substitutes.
3. **Under-covered?** No analysts, no memes—price dislocations.
4. **Profitable scarcity?** Pricing power, not dilution.
5. **Catalyst?** Earnings beat, customer win, subsidies.

---

## 3. Micro pricing power: one tweet, global flows

- **UK**: Raspberry Pi +90% in two days (above).
- **Germany**: X-Fab photonics call—**+76% intraday**, ~3× YTD; Reuters cited "pushed by people on X."
- **Sweden**: Sivers ($SIVE)—CPO laser source; doubled after her post; later Jabil deal + CHIPS funding.
- **China A-shares**: After Huang's robotics comment, she praised **Harmonic Drive (绿的谐波)**—limit-up same afternoon, ~40% that month. **She said she didn't own it—free opinion only.**

That's **super-influencer pricing power** in the AI era.

---

## 4. She barely monetizes followers

Her only product: **$1/month X subscription**—she once disclosed ~$1,595/month net from 8,605 subs.

No courses, signal groups, copy-trade apps, ads, or gifts. She warns: **any external group using her name is a scam.** Creator payouts reportedly go to dog rescue.

**Low price + massive subs = credibility + virality.** Passing Musk on subs was its own marketing event.

---

## 5. What retail can learn

**1. Follow the vine.** Supply-chain profits arrive in waves—materials first, components next, assembly last.

**2. Separate panic from fundamentals.** Macro selloffs in true bottlenecks can be mispricings.

**3. Ask upstream.** For every hype name: *what tiny irreplaceable part gates the giant?*

**4. Explain hard things simply.** Her gift—materials science in meme language—is a content superpower.

---

## 6. Four big risks—read before copying

**1. Unaudited performance.** Self-reported 630%/4502%/225× returns aren't verified; third-party trackers show ~54–59% hit rate, 40–65% avg return—and blow-ups to ~0.1%.

**2. Liquidity traps.** Micro-cap names gap up on her posts; exits are narrow—**you may be exit liquidity.**

**3. Self-fulfilling prophecy.** At this influence, did analysis predict the move—or the tweet create it?

**4. Single-point tech risk.** Her optical stack assumes CPO is the only path; copper or new standards could break the thesis.

> Scam tokens using her name have collapsed **99.98%**. Avoid narrative gambling.

---

## Closing: a map, not a ticker list

Serenity embodies a new paradigm: **open-source intel + supply-chain reverse engineering + AI red-teaming** instead of homogeneous sell-side PDFs.

The uncomfortable truth: **when everyone knows AI is the future, mega-caps pay average returns; alpha lives at physical chokepoints.**

But **copying ≠ thinking.** Her value is the framework—who chokes whom—not the last rocket ticker.
